description: Unit tests for the Windows DHCP PAC file fetcher, specifically testing the DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher class and its interactions, including mocking dependencies and real network fetches.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Mock class for DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher used for unit testing, with methods to simulate DHCP queries, fetch delays, and timeouts.

classes.name: FetcherClient
classes.description: Helper class to run fetch tests, manage fetcher lifecycle, and verify results.

classes.name: DelayingDhcpQuery
classes.description: Inner class within the mock fetcher to simulate delayed DHCP responses.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Overrides to cancel ongoing fetch operations.

methods.name: ImplCreateScriptFetcher
methods.description: Creates a mock or real PAC file fetcher for testing.

methods.name: ImplCreateDhcpQuery
methods.description: Creates a DHCP query object, possibly delayed.

methods.name: ImplGetTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for fetch operations.

methods.name: OnFetcherTimer
methods.description: Callback for fetcher delay timer to simulate fetch completion.

methods.name: FinishTest
methods.description: Signals test completion in the mock fetcher.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Waits for fetch operation to complete and verifies expected error code.

methods.name: FinishTestAllowCleanup
methods.description: Completes the test and allows cleanup.
